For three and a half years, ever since the spring of 2023, when SpaceX launched the first of its massive Starship rockets, the company has been promising that before too long the towering, stainless steel machine would get to orbit. This morning, on the 14th such launch, it made good on that boast. “Starship performs its orbital insertion burn and enters orbit of Earth for the first time,” SpaceX announced on X at 9:15 a.m. ET, along with a video of that engine maneuver. It took just 25 minutes and 17 seconds for the spacecraft to travel from its launch pad in Starbase, Texas, to its circular orbit 170 miles high. There is no overstating how important today’s success was to SpaceX’s—and NASA’s—long-term plans. item.description:
The exterior of the Eli Lilly and Company headquarters in Indianapolis on June 13, 2024. —wellesenterprises—Getty Images Two new studies published in separate journals show that an experimental drug developed by Eli Lilly leads to meaningful weight loss. One study, published in the Lancet and presented at the European Association for the Study of Diabetes , tested the drug retatrutide in people who were overweight or obese and had Type 2 diabetes: a population in which weight-loss medications have historically been less effective. People who took the highest dose lost about 18.8% of their starting body weight, while people who took a placebo lost 5.1%.
